extraction.rule: block lines 21-133 read at the record pin; a numeral token is a maximal digit run with internal '.' or ',' groups (regex \d+(?:[.,]\d+)*|\.\d+) or a number word (zero..twelve, half; case-insensitive, word-bounded). rows.comment: Added in this revision (checker's missed unit; the matcher does not extract the number word). 'Our tens' is the magnitude of our trials run per stage. Each count is two-digit (24, 48, 96; checked on the bbc9ffe artifacts: b2r_control_* n = 96, b2r_explore_* 48 injected / 48 control), so the magnitude itself reproduces. As the clause's contrast with '~800 injected and ~80 control' it falls under W5 (results/raw/2026-10-08_note-N2vi-source.md@09c3a8c:620, condition 4): a figure derived from the not-found n is cut with it, or stated with its premise and unit. If the sentence is restated rather than cut, the contrast is not uniform. Under the per-configuration reading, our criterion arm's 96 control trials per stage exceed ~80, so the control-side contrast fails for that arm; only the exploration arm (48) and the greedy run (24) sit below ~80 controls. On the injected side every arm that has injected trials (48, 24) is below ~800. Under the pooled-per-stage reading the premise gives 16000/1600 (results/raw/2026-10-08_note-N2vi-source.md@09c3a8c:30), and the contrast holds on both sides.
